## Why This Is Asked
This question tests the ability to design a tenant-isolated, privacy-conscious inference service at scale. It evaluates understanding of drift detection, model selection, controlled rollouts, and cost optimization—critical skills for building production ML systems in enterprise environments.

## Key Concepts
- **SageMaker Inference Recommender / Multi-Model Endpoints**: Auto-select instance types or share GPU instances across models for cost optimization
- **PrivateLink and VPC Isolation**: Ensure per-tenant network isolation and data residency compliance
- **Per-tenant Routing, IAM, and Data Residency**: Separate tenant traffic, enforce access controls, and meet regional compliance requirements
- **Drift Monitoring**: Use SageMaker Clarify to detect data drift, feature attribution drift, and model quality degradation
- **Canary Rollouts & Rollback**: Gradual traffic shifting with automated triggers based on latency p99, error rates, and custom metrics
- **Cost Model**: Estimate based on instance hours, inference calls, and data transfer; use multi-model endpoints to reduce GPU costs by 40-60% for lower-traffic tenants
